Asturian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

entrevista +‎ -ar

Verb

[edit]

entrevistar (first-person singular indicative present entrevisto, past participle entrevistáu)

  1. to interview (obtain an interview)

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From entrevista (“interview”) +‎ -ar.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): (careful pronunciation) /ẽ.tɾe.visˈta(ʁ)/ [ẽ.tɾe.visˈta(h)], (natural pronunciation) /ĩ.tɾe.visˈta(ʁ)/ [ĩ.tɾe.visˈta(h)]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): (careful pronunciation) /ẽ.tɾe.visˈta(ʁ)/ [ẽ.tɾe.visˈta(h)], (natural pronunciation) /ĩ.tɾe.visˈta(ʁ)/ [ĩ.tɾe.visˈta(h)]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): (careful pronunciation) /ẽ.tɾe.visˈta(ɾ)/, (natural pronunciation) /ĩ.tɾe.visˈta(ɾ)/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): (careful pronunciation) /ẽ.tɾe.viʃˈta(ʁ)/ [ẽ.tɾe.viʃˈta(χ)], (natural pronunciation) /ĩ.tɾe.viʃˈta(ʁ)/ [ĩ.tɾe.viʃˈta(χ)]
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): (careful pronunciation) /ẽ.tɾe.visˈta(ɻ)/, (natural pronunciation) /ĩ.tɾe.visˈta(ɻ)/
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ẽ.tɾɨ.viʃˈtaɾ/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ẽ.tɾɨ.viʃˈtaɾ/
    • (Northern Portugal) IPA(key): /ẽ.tɾɨ.biʃˈtaɾ/ [ẽ.tɾɨ.βiʃˈtaɾ]
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /ẽ.tɾɨ.viʃˈta.ɾi/

  • Hyphenation: en‧tre‧vis‧tar

Verb

[edit]

entrevistar (first-person singular present entrevisto, first-person singular preterite entrevistei, past participle entrevistado)

  1. to interview (obtain an interview from)

Usage notes

[edit]
  • Do not confuse with entrever.
